description: The line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny,” illustrates the evolution of Word Error Rate (WER) over six training epochs for five different quantization configurations of the Whisper tiny model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” spans from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” ranges from approximately 25 to 75, with major grid lines every 10 units. Five distinct lines represent different model variants: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (solid gray line with circle markers) starts at WER ≈ 70 and declines to ≈ 50 by epoch 6; “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (solid gray line with square markers) begins at ≈ 61 and ends at ≈ 50; “tiny int4” (dashed gray line with circle markers) starts at ≈ 61 and ends at ≈ 57; “tiny int8” (dashed gray line with square markers) begins at ≈ 51 and ends at ≈ 50; and “tiny full” (dotted gray line with triangle markers) starts at ≈ 30 and rises slightly to ≈ 40 by epoch 6. All lines show a general downward or stable trend in WER over epochs, except “tiny full,” which exhibits a slight upward drift.
